correctness.rationale: For 1<ϑ<2 the two inverse branches are 1/2±u² and both absolute derivatives are w=u/(K+ϑu), with w(1)=0 and w(0)=λ=(1+ϑ/2)^-1. Applying the fixed-point equation to the W^{2,1} representative gives zero endpoint values; w(x)/(1-x)→1/(2K²) gives the derivative at one, and differentiation at zero gives h'(0)=λ²[h'(0)-h'(1)]. The uniform BV step can be made explicit: on a rank-n cylinder the inverse-iterate weight is a product of n monotone factors, each of sup norm and variation at most λ, so the product has sup ≤λ^n and variation ≤nλ^n. The product inequality followed by sup_C|φ|≤Var_C φ+||φ||_{1,C}/|C| gives a variation coefficient (n+1)λ^n and a weak-norm coefficient at most nλ^n/min_C|C|. Choose a fixed large n and restrict ϑ near two; fixed-rank cylinder lengths tend to 2^-n and the variation coefficient is strictly below one. Compactness then gives L¹ subsequential limits. Invariance passes to the limit: the weights converge in L¹ to 1/2, and the inverse branches converge uniformly; for BV test inputs, the L¹ composition error is bounded by a constant times the inverse-branch displacement times the variation (integrate the variation measure against the affine limiting branch). The unique tent-map density is one: for BV inputs the affine cylinder average differs from the integral by at most 2^-n Var. The disjoint-cylinder sup inequality in RESULT.md then gives locally uniform interior convergence. At x=1-K²s the scaled weight and interior preimages give U uniformly for bounded s. At x=K²s, left-preimage rescaling tends uniformly to s/2, the symmetric right-preimage term uses U, and iteration leaves a uniformly geometric remainder, giving V and slopes 1 and 1/3. Both profiles tend to one at large s by bounded convergence; no global uniform rescaled claim follows. The frozen verify.py and check_output.txt check samples of inversion, weights and profile recursion/slope sum, not the actual density's uniform BV bound or finite-parameter derivative equation; the supplied script was inspected but not run.
